title: Push Constants Unify to 128 bytes
description: Successfully unified push constant structures to exactly 128 bytes to eliminate VUID-10069 validation errors

technical_summary.problem: Multiple push constant structures had different sizes (108, 132, 156 bytes) causing VUID-10069 validation errors when shaders expected 128 bytes
technical_summary.solution: Reorganized MeshPushConstants and SPHMeshPushConstants to exactly 128 bytes with proper alignment and padding
technical_summary.approach: Struct layout optimization and explicit padding fields to achieve consistent 128-byte size

key_changes: Moved lightDirection after cameraPos+particleSize for better alignment
Added explicit _padding field for exact 128-byte size
Reorganized fields to minimize compiler-inserted padding
Reused lightDirection/lightIntensity fields for SPH gradient/pressure
Reorganized field order to match 128-byte layout

MeshParticleRenderer.h.SPHMeshPushConstants: Expanded from 108 to 128 bytes with field reuse

MeshParticleRenderer.cpp.pipeline_creation: Added debug output for both pipeline push constant sizes
MeshParticleRenderer.cpp.push_constant_population: Updated SPH constants to use new 128-byte layout

shaders.particle_mesh.frag: Updated push constant layout to match C++ struct
shaders.particle_mesh.mesh: Updated push constant layout to match fragment shader

before.pipeline_status: External-only pipeline creation failing due to size mismatch

after.vuid_10069: ELIMINATED - All pipelines now use consistent 128-byte ranges
after.pipeline_status: Both main and SPH pipelines create successfully

CR 1027 DEBUG (SPH Pipeline): SPHMeshPushConstants size = 128 bytes, expected 128 bytes

SPHMeshPushConstants_128_bytes.field_reuse: lightDirection = SPH gradient, lightIntensity = pressure scale

testing.results: Clean push constant validation, no VUID-10069 errors
